role: Builds the sun and moon quads of the sky pass: the sun (radius 30 at height 100) and the moon phase cell of moon_phases.png (radius 20 at height -100), rotated by the celestial angle, handed to a caller-supplied quad callback.
notes: Called from raster.c, which supplies the quad rasterizer. Only the sun and moon part of RenderGlobal.renderSky is here; the sky dome, sunrise fan and stars are elsewhere (raster.c), not verified by me. raster_sky2_stars is RenderGlobal.renderStars: the 1500-draw Random(10842L) list built once, under the same rotation as the sun and moon.
